newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TOTTENHAM UPSTAGE LEEDS BY SIGNING SCALES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOTTENHAM UPSTAGE LEEDS BY SIGNING SCALES.

text.p: Tottenham signed Liverpool central defender John Scales for 2.6 million pounds sterling ($4.3 million) on Sunday -- a few hours after Leeds insisted they had captured his signature.
Gerry Francis, manager of English premier league Tottenham, said: "I am absolutely delighted to have been able to sign a player of John's ability and quality. It is not often they become available."

Scales, who was released by Leeds as a youth, has agreed a three-and-a-half years contract with Tottenham and becomes their second signing in a week after the recruitment of 2.6 million pounds ($4.3 million) Norwegian striker Steffen Iversen from Rosenborg.
Leeds had shown every confidence earlier in the day that talks between the player and club manager George Graham on Friday had been enough to persuade Scales to join them.
Chairman Bill Fotherby even said the defender would be unveiled as a Leeds' player at a news conference on Monday.
"He is a Leeds boy and this is where he wants to be. He knows this club is moving forward," Fotherby said.
